title: Language of the unary family
statement: Let $L$ be a language of Boolean words such that every word in $L$ consists entirely of true bits. The language recognized by the circuit family that uses the all-ones circuit at length $n$ exactly when the length-$n$ all-true word belongs to $L$ is equal to $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of Boolean words
